title.en: GitHub Copilot launches generally, putting AI pair programming in every major IDE
title.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 正式发布，AI 结对编程进入所有主流 IDE

searchSummary.en: GitHub Copilot launched in June 2022, putting AI pair programming in every developer’s IDE. How OpenAI Codex changed software development and the meaning of coding.
searchSummary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 于 2022 年 6 月正式发布，AI 结对编程进入了每个开发者的编辑器。了解 OpenAI Codex 如何改变了软件开发和编程的意义。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot, powered by OpenAI Codex, became generally available in June 2022 as a subscription service integrated into Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Neovim. Copilot could generate entire functions from a comment, autocomplete lines in real time, and suggest test cases — fundamentally changing how millions of developers write code. It was the first mainstream AI tool embedded directly into the software development workflow.
summary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 由 OpenAI Codex 驱动，于 2022 年 6 月正式以订阅服务的形式发布，集成到 Visual Studio Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim 中。Copilot 可以根据注释生成完整函数、实时自动补全代码行并建议测试用例——从根本上改变了数百万开发者的编码方式。它是第一个直接嵌入软件开发工作流的 AI 主流工具。

narrative.en: Copilot began as a technical preview in June 2021, letting developers try an AI that could suggest code in real time. The underlying model, OpenAI Codex (a GPT-3 descendant fine-tuned on public GitHub repositories), was announced in August 2021. The response was divided — some developers found it transformative, others worried about code quality, licensing, and job displacement. By the time Copilot reached general availability in June 2022, it had over 1 million users and was supported by major IDEs. Microsoft and GitHub built a business around it: $10/month for individual developers, $19/user/month for organizations. The long-term impact on software development has been debated but undeniable: by 2024, an estimated 40%+ of code in major repositories was AI-assisted. Copilot triggered a wave of competitors (Amazon CodeWhisperer, Tabnine, Replit Ghostwriter) and established AI code generation as a standard developer tool. Legal challenges followed: a class-action lawsuit was filed against GitHub, Microsoft, and OpenAI alleging copyright infringement by training on public repositories without attribution. The case raised fundamental questions about AI training data and open-source licensing that remain unresolved.
narrative.zhHans: Copilot 始于 2021 年 6 月的技术预览版，让开发者尝试一个能实时建议代码的 AI。底层模型 OpenAI Codex（GPT-3 在公开 GitHub 仓库上微调的后代）于 2021 年 8 月公布。反应是分裂的——一些开发者认为它具有变革意义，其他人则担心代码质量、许可和就业替代。到 2022 年 6 月 Copilot 正式发布时，它已有超过 100 万用户，并得到主要 IDE 的支持。微软和 GitHub 围绕它建立了一个业务：个人开发者每月 $10，组织用户每人每月 $19。对软件开发的长期影响虽有争议但不可否认：到 2024 年，估计 40%+ 的主要仓库中的代码是 AI 辅助的。Copilot 引发了一波竞争对手（Amazon CodeWhisperer、Tabnine、Replit Ghostwriter），并将 AI 代码生成确立为标准开发者工具。法律挑战随之而来：针对 GitHub、微软和 OpenAI 提起的集体诉讼指控其未经署名在公共代码仓库上训练构成版权侵权。该案引发了关于 AI 训练数据和开源许可基本问题，至今未解决。

description.en: First mainstream AI pair-programming tool that could generate entire functions from natural language comments. Demonstrated that LLMs fine-tuned on code could be practically useful in daily development workflows, not just research curiosities.
description.zhHans: 第一个能够从自然语言注释生成完整函数的主流 AI 结对编程工具。证明了在代码上微调的大语言模型在日常开发工作流中具有实际用途，而不仅仅是研究上的新奇事物。

description.en: Raised concerns about job displacement for entry-level developers, code quality accountability, and the future of software engineering education. The GitHub Copilot class-action lawsuit (2022) became a landmark case for AI training data and open-source licensing.
description.zhHans: 引发了对初级开发者就业替代、代码质量责任以及软件工程教育未来的担忧。GitHub Copilot 集体诉讼（2022 年）成为 AI 训练数据和开源许可的标志性案例。

text.en: GitHub Copilot became generally available on June 21, 2022, as a subscription service integrated into Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Neovim, serving over 1 million users at launch.
text.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 于 2022 年 6 月 21 日正式发布，作为订阅服务集成到 Visual Studio Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim 中，发布时服务超过 100 万用户。

sources.quote: GitHub Copilot is now available to all developers as a subscription service, integrated into Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Neovim.
We are introducing GitHub Copilot, a new AI pair programmer that helps you write better code.
